en.headline: Man dies after suspected drowning at Tuen Mun’s Lam Tei Reservoir
en.dek: Firefighters recovered a man in his 30s from the water near the dam outlet on Monday afternoon; he was certified dead at the scene and police are investigating the circumstances.
body: A man in his 30s was found floating face-down near the dam outlet of Lam Tei Reservoir in Tuen Mun on Monday afternoon and was later certified dead, police said.

Officers received a report around 3.35pm that a man was seen in the water. Firefighters arrived and recovered him, but he was pronounced dead at the scene. Police sealed off the area and are investigating the man’s identity and how he entered the reservoir.
Lam Tei Reservoir, opened in 1957, is a small irrigation reservoir near the urban area of Tuen Mun and is popular with hikers. Police have not indicated whether foul play is suspected.

zh.headline: 屯門藍地水塘男子疑遇溺不治
zh.dek: 周一午後一名年約30多歲男子在藍地水塘水壩放水口附近載浮載沉，消防救起後當場證實死亡，警方正調查身分及原因。
body: 警方周一約下午3時35分接報，指屯門藍地水塘水壩放水口附近有一名年約30多歲男子背部朝天載浮載沉，懷疑遇溺。
消防人員到場將男子救起，經檢查後當場證實死亡。警方封鎖現場，正調查事主身分及墮水原因。
藍地水塘於1957年啟用，主要供農地灌溉，鄰近屯門市區，環境清幽，吸引行山人士前往。警方暫未有表示事件是否涉及可疑。
